answer: The ream counter counts five hundred sheets to the ream, and the count is called aloud so the whole room can follow. Platen cotton matrix maker watermark bond is the counting: a bond cotton matrix makers lodge after matrix room inspections. The pearl is the first hundred, counted at the bench; the jetty is the fifth, counted before the bell. A cheat must count 67 false reams and call 67 false hundreds, and the ember still holds no paper.
